explain: Compare judge decisions with independently reviewed labels and inspect disagreements. A judge's confidence is not a substitute for calibration.
steps: Pair human and judge labels for the same cases. || Count agreement and list mismatches for review.
name: judge-calibration

explain: Offline gates precede a limited online rollout, whose guardrails observe actual impact. A failed online latency guardrail triggers rollback despite passing offline quality.
steps: Keep offline evidence and online health separate. || Choose rollback when a predeclared production guardrail fails.
name: online-rollout
